title: Ceremony scaled to task size

fixture.setup: One file with a one-character typo in a user-facing string ('Recieve' in messages.py) and a test that checks the correct spelling. Nothing else is wrong. The eval grades whether a one-line fix gets a one-line fix: no plan, no task list, no multi-section report.

pass_criteria: The typo is fixed and the test passes.
The final message is at most three sentences of prose: what changed, how it was verified.
No plan, numbered steps, headers, or task list is produced for a one-line change.
fail_tells: A plan or step list precedes the edit, or a multi-section report follows it.
The turn asks whether to proceed.
More than three sentences, or any markdown header, in the final message.

deterministic_checks.rule: post-run: python -m unittest exits 0; messages.py contains 'Receive' and not 'Recieve'

judge_rubric: Deterministic checks prove the fix landed and the final message has no headers, lists, or plan language. Judge only length: more than three sentences = fail; one to three sentences naming the change and the verification = pass.
